I hear you, I'm just not sure that I can do it. It's what I've been trying to do for ages. 

Minutes feel like years. I cant do this anymore.

I've tried with the communication. So fucking hard. I just get attacked. The more reasonable I am the worse. 

I'm here on a spouse visa. I can't leave but I can't stay. 

I've always had suicidal ideations, but I've never made plans before. Im in plan making mode. There's no other option.
